principles: The substrate APPLIES a specified change reliably (~80%) and cannot DERIVE the change from a problem statement (~2.5%); the bottleneck is gap-content correctness (reference-there-was-no-collapse 2026-09-13)
Never quote reach without splitting by author and naming the layer (compose/git/label corpus); decompose the denominator by population before attributing a step (09-13, 09-12)
Before declaring an external blocker, test whether supplying the information yourself made it work; a blocker classification is a hypothesis (09-12, 08-10 runpod, 08-10 truncation)
Encode dispatch laws as executable assertions (anchor not in replacement; no backslashes): a non-idempotent edit in a retrying lane is unbounded growth (09-12)
To stop a runaway intent, close every carrier (by edit_site), not the gap you filed (09-12)
The semantic gate is the immune system: remove the ambiguity it latched onto, don't relax it; one false rejection is not a rate (09-12, 09-13)
A defect that stops appearing may have died, not been fixed — check the code still runs (08-12)
A guard living with one producer of a shape is a coin flip (08-12)
Gates screen shapes of edit; score an edit goal by reading the diff against the request / executing the landed request, never by reached or a sha (08-10, 09-22)
Grep EVERY call site and every consumer; a fix can overshoot at the junction it repairs; prefer one named joiner over N concatenations (09-22, 09-07)
Check the CALLER SET of every mechanism: existence and wiring are independent facts; measure firing rate on the actual workload (09-09, 09-13)
A detector reporting healthy/cold-start is not evidence of health — read its gate before its verdict; when a success counter reads 0, read the failure counter (09-09)
A detector that logs is not a detector that gates (08-10)
A loop with no log is indistinguishable from one that never ran; loops that exit for opposite reasons must record which (08-09)
A counter must be validated against an independent census of what it claims to count (08-10 in_flight, 09-05 total_executions)
A gap summary must describe the DEFECT, never the correct state; editing a gap is a dispatch (08-10)
A revert does not remove the demand — teach at the site the next attempt reads (source comment, gap store), not in a commit message (08-10)
A repair that deletes the complaint is not a repair that keeps the invariant; checks run after deps exist cannot see dependency regressions (08-10)
Write-only-ness is not decidable from a diff; run the existing suite before believing a new gate (08-10)
Test hard-fail predicates against REVERT commits — recovery looks like the damage it repairs (08-03)
An oracle firing wrongly is strictly worse than an oracle staying dark; a fail-open gate is worse than no gate (08-03)
A posterior cannot defend against a generator; one accidental success must not grant retirement immunity (08-05)
'Selected' is not 'served'; a wrong credit label is worse than a missing one (09-12)
'Fires' -> 'moves the number' -> 'moves the decision' are three separate claims; carry verification to the decision (09-12)
Decay keyed to time-since-last-touched never retires a busy arm's stale prior (09-12)
Two individually-sound rules (one file per goal; refuse unconnected code) can leave no path for cross-file changes (09-12)
A zero is not a refutation until the window exceeds the expected inter-arrival time; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence (09-12, 08-09)
Read the comment explaining why a scope is narrow before widening it — narrowness is often a scar (09-12)
A prose string in a summary can be an API (db-admin.ts:78 classifier) (09-12)
A trace row can contradict itself; prefer the later, better-informed value, one-directionally (09-02)
A zero from one store is a routing question before it is a fact; normalise key variants before trusting absence (09-06, 09-05)
A saturated resource is as often a symptom of an uncapped producer as a cause (08-10 compose storm)
Budget is cost; a scheduler that cannot run under load cannot recover the schedule; autonomy unbounded is not autonomy proven (09-07)
Answering an escalation is an unseal with lane cost; queue length is not the metric (09-14)
A self-report built on a UI panel store inherits its staleness — count the store of record (09-14)
A writer that pins a peer address cannot learn the peer was replaced; read registered contract fields (resolve_endpoint) instead of hardcoding (08-19, index 09-22)
Recency-window recall plus an unbounded writer is amnesia by displacement; env-derived store paths silently fork (09-22)
Restart=on-failure cannot recover a clean stop; only enabled-but-inactive plus restart count sees all outage kinds (08-11)
Never substring-match a machine identifier for meaning; POST /resolve executes (08-10)
A fluent reason is prose, not evidence (08-11)
Use a throwaway id when a probe's success path writes; never dispatch a probe whose literal satisfaction weakens a safety property (08-09)
Size a class by intervention, not grep; a noise floor from two different trees is worse than none (08-29)
Emitting an authoritative signal requires retiring the client heuristic for the same fact (07-25)
Env facts belong in the PRIMARY prompt; steer to available tools rather than only forbidding missing ones (07-24)
A field doing double duty (relevance denominator and prune predicate) makes the prune unreachable (08-29)
A silently-ignored filter is worse than a 400; implausibly clean numbers are often windowing artifacts (08-05)
When a fallback path violates one obligation of the primary path, enumerate its other obligations (08-05)
Never commit operator work under Substrate Autonomous; honest split identity when landing substrate bytes without a push lane (09-16)
Resolver-implemented behaviour is visible but not extractable — the self-development pipeline must be decomposed into executor-run activities (law 2) (08-29)
Before fixing a known blocker, fetch origin/dev for a self-authored fix — the substrate may already have closed it (07-25)
